seoTitle: Torque Converter: N m, lbf ft, kgf m, in lb
metaDescription: Convert newton-metres, foot-pounds, inch-pounds and kilogram-force metres for wheel nuts and bolts. Free, offline.
intro: Converts torque between newton-metres, pound-force feet and inches, kilogram-force metres and centimetres, ounce-force inches and more.
why:
Torque specs appear as N m in one manual and lbf ft in another. A wrong conversion can under-tighten a wheel or strip a thread.

This tool uses standard gravity and the exact pound, and shows all units at once. It does not know your fastener, so always follow the maker.
howTo: Choose the unit it is in.

faq.q: How many lbf ft is 100 N m?

faq.a: Kilogram-force metre, an older metric unit. 1 kgf m is 9.80665 N m.

faq.q: Can I trust this for safety parts?
faq.a: The maths is exact, but use the figure from your vehicle or part maker and a calibrated wrench.
